source_units.text: I am following a rugby officiating lesson and need to revise its decision categories.
Use the exact labels "Advantage Decisions", "Offside Lines", "Restart Procedures" in the schedule, with at least 25 total minutes assigned to each.
Within that coverage, "Advantage Decisions" needs at least 35 total minutes.
There is a firm ceiling of 35 study minutes on each date.
The last usable study date is 2027-02-04, and sessions may fall on that day.
